newsitem.title: UK: Standard Chartered off on downgrade talk.
newsitem.headline: Standard Chartered off on downgrade talk.

text.p: Shares in Standard Chartered eased amid talk that ABN AMRO Hoare Govett was preparing to downgrade the stock, dealers said.
At 0856 GMT, the shares were off 7-1/2p to 651-1/2p, even as the rest of the bank sector held steady to firmer.
Shares in HSBC Holdings slipped 1-1/2p to 1289p on talk that it may also be the subject of a downgrade, they said.
ABN AMRO Hoare Govett bank analyst Peter Toeman said he had not yet downgraded Standard Chartered or HSBC, but was considering the possibility.
"It depends on foreign exchange forecasts," he said. "If sterling is above 1.60 (against the U.S. dollar) through the end of 1997, it would knock off about four percent off profits."
